title: Patch: the first page load drops its catalog copy and lazy-loads the Chinese tables
notes: The first page load no longer ships its own copy of the card catalog or the Chinese card tables (#4180). Every screen reads the engine module's registered catalog through game/currentCatalog.ts, and cards/chinese.ts loads its two sidecars on demand via loadCardTables(). Nothing visible changes. Claims --visual because the refactor touches apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000), a micro of no family.

player.title: Faster first load
fixes: The first page loads faster on a slow connection, with the same cards and words.
